name: Fenland Loop
quote: Fenland Loop 1.9 km loop 40 minutes
why: Short interpretive loop through old-growth spruce forest near Banff town.

name: Johnston Canyon Trail (to Upper Falls)
quote: Johnston Canyon Trail (to Upper Falls) 2.4 km one way 2 hours
why: Canyon walk on catwalks past the Lower Falls to the Upper Falls.

name: Tunnel Mountain Summit Trail
quote: Tunnel Mountain Summit Trail 2.3 km one way 2 hours
why: Switchbacking climb to a low summit overlooking Banff town and the Bow Valley.

name: C-Level Cirque Trail
quote: C-Level Cirque Trail 3.8 km one way 3 hours
why: Climb past old Bankhead mine remains to a cirque on Cascade Mountain.

name: Sulphur Mountain Trail
quote: Sulphur Mountain Trail 4.8 km one way 4 hours
why: Switchback climb from the Upper Hot Springs to the Sulphur Mountain summit ridge.

name: Boom Lake Trail
quote: Boom Lake Trail 5.1 km one way 3 to 4 hours
why: Forest trail to a large alpine lake off Highway 93 South.

name: Cascade Amphitheatre Trail
quote: Cascade Amphitheatre Trail 6.8 km one way 6 hours
why: From Mount Norquay up to a meadow in a natural amphitheatre on Cascade Mountain.

name: Rockbound Lake Trail
quote: Rockbound Lake Trail 8.5 km one way 6 to 7 hours
why: Long climb behind Castle Mountain past Tower Lake to a cirque lake.

name: Bourgeau Lake Trail
quote: Bourgeau Lake Trail 6.7 km one way 6 hours
why: Steady forest climb to a lake in a glacially carved amphitheatre.

name: Lake Louise Lakeshore Trail
quote: Distance (one way): 2.3 km Elevation gain: 175 m Elevation loss: 75 m Estimated time round trip: 1 hour
why: Easy stroll along the shore of Lake Louise to the inflowing creek.

name: Lake Agnes Trail
quote: Lake Agnes Trail Description: Hike up a well-maintained trail to a beautiful lake tucked underneath towering peaks. Enjoy the scenery and visit a quaint European-style tea house (seasonal). Pack out your garbage! Distance (one way): 3.9 km
why: Climb from Lake Louise to Lake Agnes and its tea house.

name: Plain of Six Glaciers Trail
quote: Distance (one way): 5.9 km Elevation gain: 595 m Elevation loss: 250 m Estimated time round trip: 4 hours Trailhead: Lake Louise Lakeshore
why: Hike beyond Lake Louise to glacier views and a tea house.

name: Larch Valley/Minnestimma Lakes Trail
quote: Larch Valley/Minnestimma Lakes Trail Description: Hike into a unique larch forest high above Moraine Lake. The views of the Ten Peaks are breathtaking. Distance (one way): 4.5 km
why: Climb from Moraine Lake into a larch valley facing the Ten Peaks.

name: Consolation Lakes Trail
quote: Consolation Lakes Trail Description: Enjoy a short hike during your visit to Moraine Lake. This easy trail to the first lake offers rewarding views of high alpine meadows, scree slopes, and the Quadra Glacier. Distance (one way): 2.9 km
why: Easy hike from Moraine Lake to the first Consolation Lake.

name: Sentinel Pass via Larch Valley Trail
quote: Sentinel Pass via Larch Valley Trail Description: Steep switchbacks lead to a high point between two famous valleys: Larch Valley and Paradise Valley. Distance (one way): 5.6 km
why: Steep climb from Moraine Lake through Larch Valley to Sentinel Pass.

name: Peyto Lake Lookout Trail
quote: A barrier-free trail (0.3 km) is available from the upper parking lot. Distance (one way): 0.6 km Elevation gain: 30 m
why: Short walk to a viewing platform above Peyto Lake.

name: Bow Glacier Falls Trail
quote: Distance (one way): 3.8 km Elevation gain: 95 m Elevation loss: 20 m Estimated time round trip: 3 hours Trailhead: Bow Lake parking lot
why: Along Bow Lake and up to the falls fed by the Wapta Icefield.

name: Parker Ridge Trail
quote: Distance (one way): 2.7 km Elevation gain: 305 m Elevation loss: 45 m Estimated time round trip: 2.5 hours Trailhead: Parker Ridge parking lot
why: Switchbacks to a ridge overlooking the Saskatchewan Glacier.

name: Helen Lake Trail
quote: Helen Lake Trail Description: Tucked well into the Main Ranges of the Canadian Rockies is a breathtaking lake in a valley abounding with alpine wildlife and grand vistas. Distance (one way): 5.9 km
why: Climb from the Icefields Parkway to an alpine lake in the Main Ranges.

name: Sundance Canyon Loop
quote: Sundance Canyon Loop 9.5 km round-trip 3 hours
why: Paved path from Cave and Basin to a hiking-only loop around Sundance Canyon.
